checks: Host sees campaign ownership and private session code
Host field menu leaves co-op simulation running
Wrong invite gives an actionable error and permits retry
Guest sees correct owner and roster without host invite disclosure
Sensitivity drag completes without a control-rate disconnect
Dragged sensitivity persists for this campaign visit
Guest visit setting restores after leaving and joining again
Ending the party returns both clients to profiles
hostPolicy: Only the host's world advances. Connected players keep district unlocks once per character; joining after completion grants no past unlocks. Guest dialogue and settings save for this host's campaign; their own world stays unchanged. No automatic catch-up or host migration.
guestParty: Visiting UI-HOST2's campaign | Party 2/8: UI-HOST2, UI-GUEST2
method: Normal UI controls in two live browser pages; invalid invite/retry, menu live-tick sample, leave/rejoin, 40-step range drag and end-party. Private loopback SQLite database, no gameplay-state injection.

finalStyleCheck.method: Fresh navigation and computed style read after final copyability adjustment.

limits: Two local browser pages, not real WAN or eight human players.
No clean-machine, native focus or reference-hardware qualification.
